name: Color Sensor

maxRange.label: Max range (m)
maxRange.desc: How far down the beam a target is still read. The beam is cast along local +Z, so aim the sensor by rotating it.

showBeam.label: Show beam
showBeam.desc: Draw the beam line in the viewport. A viewing aid only - hiding it does not change what the sensor reads.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this part to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

colorTag.label: Color code tag
colorTag.desc: Where the detected colour code is published. It reads 0 both when nothing is in range and when the colour is too ambiguous to call, so pair it with a presence sensor if the difference matters.
